property_summary: For any inputs with a single recipient in _tos, C always calls the callee function with selector transferFrom(address,address,uint256) (so the recorder observes that exact decoded args and increments its counter), whereas the mutant sometimes calls the different selector transfer(address,address,uint256) and thus the recorder will not observe a matching decoded call (counter remains zero) for those inputs — so the reference always produces a recorded call count of 1 while the mutant can produce 0 for some inputs.
change_summary: Change the keccak256 selector to transfer(address,address,uint256) so external calls use a different selector, causing different return behavior.
